articles.title: Relief distribution among flood victims in Greater Chittagong
articles.excerpt: A severe flood hit Chittagong in the first week of this month. Extensive areas in Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, and Bandarban were submerged under water. Our emergency rapid response team was dispatched immediately with dry food packages, clean drinking water, and essential hygiene kits to assist over 10,000 affected families across remote villages.

articles.title: 3rd Imams' Training Completed Successfully
articles.excerpt: The 3rd Imams' Training by the Bandhan Paribar foundation has been successfully completed with the participation of selected Imams and community leaders nationwide.

articles.title: Qurbani for All 2026 Project Completed
articles.excerpt: Breaking all past records to bring Eid smiles to the faces of the country's underprivileged and disaster-affected people, the social project reached 35+ districts.

articles.title: Community Health Camp in Sylhet Organized
articles.excerpt: A free health camp was organized in Sylhet, providing essential medical checkups and free prescription medicine to over 500 underprivileged families.

articles.title: Youth Empowerment Workshop Held Successfully
articles.excerpt: The workshop focused on skill development and leadership training, empowering young participants from rural areas to initiate social impact initiatives.

articles.title: Tree Plantation Drive Plants 50,000 Saplings
articles.excerpt: To combat climate vulnerability and coastal erosion, our volunteer network planted fruit-bearing and timber saplings across 12 coastal sub-districts.

articles.title: Clean Water Tube-Well Project Phase 4 Completed
articles.excerpt: Installation of 80 deep tube-wells brings pure, safe drinking water to salinity-affected coastal villages in Satkhira and Khulna.

articles.title: Winter Blanket Drive Prepares Aid for 20,000 Families
articles.excerpt: High-density thermal blankets and warm winter clothing sets are being procured for cold-wave vulnerable northern districts.

articles.title: Emergency Blood Donation Camp Collects 300 Bags
articles.excerpt: Volunteers and university students gathered to donate blood for thalassemia patients and emergency surgical cases at Central Red Cross Center.

articles.title: Women Entrepreneurship Micro-Grant Ceremony
articles.excerpt: 50 rural women received sewing machines and interest-free startup capital to establish independent tailoring businesses.

articles.title: Educational Kit Distribution to 5,000 Students
articles.excerpt: School bags, notebooks, uniforms, and stationary items distributed to underprivileged primary students across 15 schools.

articles.title: Wheelchair & Assistive Equipment Distribution
articles.excerpt: Customized wheelchairs and hearing aids delivered to 100 physically challenged individuals to support mobility and independence.

articles.title: Anti-Drug Awareness Campaign in Colleges
articles.excerpt: Seminars and interactive theater performances organized to educate youth about the dangers of drug addiction and mental wellness.

articles.title: Iftar Package Distribution for Ramadan 2026
articles.excerpt: Month-long dry food packages and fresh warm Iftar meals served to over 40,000 fasting day-laborers and street children.

articles.title: Emergency Food Relief in Char Land Regions
articles.excerpt: Boats deployed to deliver essential food packs containing rice, lentils, oil, and salt to isolated char island communities.

articles.title: Winter Clothing Drive Reaches Coldest Districts
articles.excerpt: Warm jackets, sweaters, and woolen caps distributed to 8,000 children and elderly citizens in Panchagarh and Kurigram.

articles.title: Orphanage Facility Renovation Completed
articles.excerpt: Upgraded living dormitories, solar lighting systems, and study rooms inaugurated for 120 resident orphan children.

articles.title: Vocational IT Skills Training Batch 5 Graduation
articles.excerpt: 85 underprivileged youths completed a 3-month course in web development, graphic design, and freelance skills.

testimonials.quote: When the severe flood submerged our entire village, Bandhan Paribar's rescue team reached us with dry food and clean water within 24 hours. They gave us hope when we lost everything.
testimonials.name: Abdul Karim

testimonials.quote: The Imams' Training program completely transformed my perspective on community service. I learned financial management and disaster coordination to lead my neighborhood effectively.
testimonials.name: Maulana Mahmudullah

testimonials.quote: Receiving a free sewing machine and vocational training enabled me to earn an independent income for my three children. I am forever grateful for this self-reliance initiative.
testimonials.name: Fatema Begum

aboutData.mission: To build an ideal, self-reliant, and compassionate welfare society by serving humanity, supporting disaster-affected communities, and empowering marginalized individuals without discrimination.
aboutData.vision: A nation where every family has access to clean water, food, education, healthcare, and dignified livelihood opportunities.
